This folder and its subfolders contain various extension codes.  
You are welcome to contribute to these tools! Once you have a new tool that can also be useful to other users, please send it to us or use the merge request functionality.  

Folders:  
* `post-processing-wf/`: various codes that can be used for processing of wave-functions generated by st codes. 
* `post-processing-qpe/`: various codes that can be used for processing of quasiparticle energies obtained by td codes. 
* `post-processing-td/`: various codes that can be used for processing of data from td runs.
* `sldae/`: tools for generating SLDAE-type functionals.
* `vortex-tracking/`: tools for tracking of quantum vortices.
* `nodal-lines/`: tools for extracting nodal lines for spin-i,mbalanced systems.
* `helmholtz-decomposition/`: a tool for performing the Helmholtz decomposition. 

Files:
* `add-relative-phasediff.c`: This code adds the phase difference with respect to the selected point in space (corner of the box).
* `parse-input-template.c`: This file demonstrates how to parse an input file.
* `extend-dataset-template.c`: This file provides a template of code that adds a new variable to the existing w-dataset.
* `st-test-external-potentials.c`: This file provides simple code that can be used for testing the correctness of the implementation of external potentials. 
* `solve-uniform.c`:  This code solves the uniform problem according to the settings from the input file. It can be used to check the correctness of solver parameters.
* `compare-datasets.c`: This tool compares two different datasets and creates a new dataset where differences of all variables are saved. 
* `interpolate-dataset.c`: This code converts an existing wdata dataset into a new one defined on a lattice with a different resolution. Use this code to learn how to use interpolation routines. 
* `resize-dataset.c`: This tool increases the dimensionality of the dataset. Use this code to learn how to use resize routines.
